purpose: Module-first causal localization of the complete upstream responses that construct the post-cue residual changes read by L11H1/H3 and L15H5 through their literal c_v maps.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capture_self_clamp_caus: Authorities, exact site inventory, base capture identity, causal-order zero tripwires, and finite metrics pass at <=19 forwards/570 examples with zero fits, backwards, or updates.
predictions.pred_b_each_reader_has_a_stable_material: For L11 and L15 separately, at least one causally prior singleton site removes >=10% of post-cue c_v response norm with cosine >=.50 in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_joint_removal_distinguishes_resid: Both all-intervening arms, with L9H1/H4 clamped as in the parent and with them live, are measured for each reader; their response-norm fractions and residual remainder are finite and reported without assuming additivity.
predictions.pred_d_l11_causal_order_tripwire: Sites attention11 and later change the L11 input response by <=1e-6, because they execute at or after the L11 attention input.
predictions.pred_e_zero_fit_complete_module_inventor: All 11 complete-module singleton removals and all three registered grouped arms execute without head splitting or outcome-dependent selection.

decision: A stable singleton advances to a fresh confirmation and within-module split only if attention is selected. If no singleton is stable but a grouped removal is material, freeze a greedy complete-module combination in causal order. If even the grouped removal is small, compile the direct MLP8 residual-skip contribution instead.
